title: SAT Command of Evidence: Tables & Graphs
description:
On SAT table and graph questions, a lot of wrong answers read the data correctly. They just don't support the claim. This lesson shows you how to find the one choice that does.

You'll learn:
• The two tests every correct answer passes: accurate AND relevant
• A 3-step method: find the claim, find exactly those data, check every number
• The 4 traps: wrong row or column, true but irrelevant, wrong direction, overgeneralization
• Harder versions: count vs. percent, and highest value vs. biggest change
• 6 practice questions with tables, bar graphs, and line graphs

All questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. All data in the tables and graphs are illustrative. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank (Information and Ideas → Command of Evidence).
